dominant_strengths: Hero artwork with vivid purple subject reads instantly against black, creating strong visceral pull and product showcase clarity.
Color Adjustments panel demonstrates real craft: dense controls, hierarchical sliders, and chromatic spectrum communicate pro-tool capability.
Apple chrome navigation and dark canvas align cleanly with native macOS/iPadOS marketing conventions, reinforcing brand trust.
dominant_weaknesses: Brief asks for a Mac app, but the showcased surface is iPad with Pencil — a category mismatch undermining intent.
Static marketing shot leaves motion_elegance and behavioral feedback unproven; no interaction states, hover, or transitions visible.
Composition relies entirely on Apple's existing keynote template, so distinctiveness and innovation register as derivative rather than authored.
fix_priorities: Re-anchor on a Mac window chrome (traffic lights, menu bar) to honor the pixelmator-pro Mac brief.
Show a secondary frame revealing tool interaction or before/after state to demonstrate behavioral depth.
Differentiate layout from stock Apple hero — add proprietary panel arrangement or signature Pixelmator UI motif.
Tighten typography in the floating panel; some labels feel undersized relative to slider density.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral dominates via the purple portrait, behavioral is implied through the adjustment panel but never demonstrated, and reflective payoff is muted by reliance on Apple's template.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially — it sells a Pixelmator-style editor convincingly, but framing it on iPad rather than Mac directly contradicts the stated mac-app brief.
